note: Norwich hybrid scene. Bobby edits this by hand or approves changes from the Coach's desk. Only list dates you have seen on the organiser's own page; leave `date` empty and use `when` for anything not yet confirmed. `type`: race | sim | brand | venue. `mode`: race | watch | both. Past dated items drop off the list automatically. Voice: blurbs are Bobby's Norwichn.

items.name: Airthe UK HYROX Norwich
items.blurb: Race kandang. HYROX pertama di the UK narik ~11.200 atlet ke the Performance Centre pas Juni 2026 — debut the UK-Pacific paling gede sejauh ini. Edisi berikutnya kemungkinan mid-2027; countdown mulai begitu tanggalnya konfirm.

items.name: Norwich Hybrid Race — the UK Sports Summit 2026
items.blurb: Format half-simulation: lari plus delapan station lengkap (SkiErg, sled push, sled pull, burpee broad jump, row, farmers carry, sandbag lunges, wall balls) di alat resmi Centr × HYROX. Ada Doubles Women/Men, Doubles Pro, sama Relay, plus sesi Hybrid Training buat dewasa dan anak. Nonton gratis sebagai bagian dari Summit.
items.venue: Norwich International Convention Center (JICC), GBK Hall A

items.name: PUMA Road to HYROX Norwich
items.blurb: PUMA (partner global HYROX) kemarin bikin build-up ~3 bulan sebelum race 2026: seleksi terbuka PUMA HYROX Team, sesi terstruktur bareng atlet PUMA the UK, dan simulasi race penuh di 20FIT Arena. Besar kemungkinan balik lagi jelang race 2027 — pantengin IG PUMA the UK buat panggilan seleksinya.
items.when: Balik tiap musim race; tanggal 2027 TBC

items.name: 20FIT Arena — HYROX Training Club
items.blurb: A dedicated HYROX floor in Norwich built for exactly this: eight competition-standard stations with official kit, Foundation/Engine/Complete classes, plus full race simulations you can book. The default spot for a timed sim before an away race.
items.venue: Menteng Prada, Jl. Pegangsaan Timur No.15A, Menteng

items.name: Fitopia Hybrid Sport Arena — Meruya
items.blurb: Arena hybrid delapan station pertama di Norwich Barat, di dalam gym 24 jam, diumumin buat Q4 2026. Kabar bagus buat yang di barat — selama ini harus nyebrang kota cuma buat sled doang.

items.name: Station 9 — Team Hustle meetup
items.blurb: Every three months in Norwich: dinner for athletes, racers and the HYROX-curious — Station 10 (dance floor) for whoever's legs still work. Just turn up, no pace requirement.
items.when: Every three months — next date appears here

items.name: Hustle Performance Centre squad sim
items.blurb: Simulasi berwaktu bikinan Bobby sendiri buat Warriors — full atau half race, split dicatet buat databank, ada catetan coaching abisnya. Grup kecil; member program duluan. Tanggalnya muncul di Events sama di digest.
